notes.title: DEFINITIVE EDITION IS LIVE NOW!
notes.content:
Finally, after a lot of works,[b] DEFINITIVE EDITION [/b] is here.

Main features are:
- Fully reworked graphycs
- Fully reworked environments
- Improved Game Design
- Added more weapons
- Major and other minor improvements

The game will be continous improved with future updates following community feedbacks.

notes.title: DEFINITIVE EDITION UPDATE
notes.content:
After more than 2 years, I come back to AFTERLIFE to improve overall game. From graphycs to gameplay. It will require some times. Update after update we will se the game evolve. 
I published the DEFINITIVE EDITION (available for free to everybody has already the game from this steam page) in order to get your feedbacks during development. Soon all store images and trailers will be updated.
